coreAdmission.predicate: target object and action are explicit
requested scope is unique and within user-directed scope
required authority entry and required SourceRefs are readable
required SourceRefs have a current snapshot or an explicit stale decision
no direct P0, authorization, or destructive-boundary violation is observed
the next required read is within the core budget

extensionTriggers.predicate: the target requires a second bounded authority domain
the requested Profile is not covered by core checks

falsePositiveCases: runtime-not-run does not block a static development Profile
missing optional capability does not block the project
unrelated stale SourceRef does not block the current scope
missing H/I receipt does not block an unrelated development Profile
budget exhaustion stops the next read instead of denying an already authorized action
alternativePath: retain the current route and cap only the affected evidence claim
recovery: re-read only the affected SourceRefs or select the explicitly bounded extension Profile
rollback: discard the decision record and re-evaluate from the same snapshot
